name: Sync DataXray Files (Nightly)
description: Rerun every DataXray search flagged 'keep in sync' each night, re-syncing its imported file assets automatically. DataXray workflows {{pack:version}} ({{pack:variant}}).

edge.description: Rerun every DataXray search flagged 'keep in sync' each night, re-syncing its imported file assets automatically, then check the files no search returns against DataXray: those it no longer has become 'Not in DataXray', the others get their attributes and classification links refreshed. DataXray workflows {{pack:version}} ({{pack:variant}}).
